name: Golden-ratio diagram into a growing bar chart
looks: A nested golden-ratio square spiral, each square labelled with its token name, draws itself from smallest to largest. It cuts to a simple bar chart of the same values, bars growing from a baseline left to right on an uneven stagger, the largest bar landing last.
build: The spiral squares scale in from 0 on an uneven stagger (smallest first), with the arc drawn via strokeDashoffset. The bar chart reuses data-infographic's bar growth (scaleY 0->1 from a bottom origin, stagger ~0.04 * (1 + 0.3 sin(2.1 i))).
sound: A soft tick per square, then a tick per bar, rising in pitch as the bars grow taller.
prompt: Show how a numeric scale is derived: draw a nested geometric diagram that builds each value from the last, then cut to a plain bar chart of the same values growing from a baseline, so the viewer sees the same progression twice, once as a rule and once as a result.
